mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squads (id, name, invite_code, owner_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{inviteCode}, #{ownerId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, invite_code, owner_id FROM squads WHERE invite_code = #{code} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, name, invite_code, owner_id FROM squads WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(*) FROM squad_members WHERE squad_id = #{squadId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM squad_members WHERE squad_id = #{squadId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad_incidents (squad_id, week_start, title) VALUES (#{squadId}, #{weekStart}, #{title}) ON CONFLICT (squad_id, week_start) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, points FROM squad_incidents WHERE squad_id = #{squadId} AND week_start = #{weekStart}
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_incidents SET points = points + #{points} WHERE id = #{incidentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad_contributions (incident_id, user_id, points) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{userId}, #{points}) ON CONFLICT (incident_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET points = squad_contributions.points + EXCLUDED.points
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, u.display_name, COALESCE(c.points, 0) AS week_points, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_days a WHERE a.user_id = m.user_id AND a.activity_date = #{today}) AS practised_today FROM squad_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN squad_contributions c ON c.user_id = m.user_id AND c.incident_id = #{incidentId} WHERE m.squad_id = #{squadId} ORDER BY m.joined_at
